shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,80p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,110p'
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"validated by.*acceptance|Status \\|\" specs src/orchestration -g '*.md' -g '*.test.ts' | head -80
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix beforeSession spec trace link placement" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
